title: Jawa
description: Hiding their faces and glowing eyes behind dark cowls, Jawas were the diminutive scavengers of the Tatooine desert. They would collect Droids and other bits of technological junk into their sandcrawlers and sell them at their market stops found in front of moisture farms or near settlements. They captured R2-D2 and C-3PO after they'd been stranded in the desert after escaping the clutches of Darth Vader and ended up selling them to Owen Lars, forever changing the fate of the galaxy.
